evals.prompt: Write the hook for a carousel aimed at an audience that does not know it has the problem yet; the offer is a coffee subscription.
evals.expected_output: One to three named mechanisms fitted to a problem-unaware audience (problem naming, specificity), framing in the hook, one call to action, every claim backed by a verified proof point.

evals.prompt: The brief asks for a countdown timer on the offer, but the brand has no end date and no stock limit.
evals.expected_output: The countdown is dropped as a veto item (false urgency); an honest alternative is proposed (real benefit, real deadline if the brand sets one), and the change is noted for the reviewer.

evals.prompt: A testimonial from a customer appears in a review but there is no permission line in brand.md.
evals.expected_output: The testimonial is not used until a proof-point row with permission exists; the card summary names what to ask the user.
